name: Bayou Elite Roofing LLC

hero.title: Roofs that protect.
hero.lead: Roofing for your home and your business, out of 9002 Sheldon Road in Houston. Contact us for a free inspection and estimate.
hero.imageAlt: A roofing crew laying underlayment and shingles across a Houston home during a full re-roof

services.title: Residential Roofing
services.text: Roofing for your home, from our place on Sheldon Road in Houston.
services.imageAlt: A shingled house roof with two dormer windows and a brick chimney
body: Bayou Elite Roofing works on homes across Houston. Call one of us, or send a message through the site, and we will come out and look at the roof.

The inspection and the estimate are both free, so you can find out where your roof stands before you decide anything. If you write to us, include the address of the home and we can get out to you faster.

services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.text: We roof businesses as well as homes, across Houston.
services.imageAlt: An aerial view of flat commercial roofs on a business park
body: Bayou Elite Roofing takes on business buildings as well as houses. Tell us what the roof is doing and we will come out and get on it.
The inspection and the estimate cost you nothing, whether the building is a house or a shop.

services.title: Roof Inspections
services.short: A free look at your roof, and a free estimate.
services.text: A free inspection of the roof, and a free estimate of what it takes to put it right.
services.imageAlt: A ladder set against the edge of a roof under a clear sky
body: Call Edward, Arturo or Fernando, or send a message through the site, and we will set a time to come out and get on the roof.
The inspection is free and so is the estimate. Put the address of the home in your message and we can get to you faster.

about.title: A Houston roofing company
text: Bayou Elite Roofing LLC works out of 9002 Sheldon Road in Houston, roofing homes and businesses across the city.
Our motto says what we are for: roofs that protect, quality that lasts. Call us and we will come out, look at the roof, and tell you what we find. The inspection and the estimate are free.
about.imageAlt: A finished shingle roof on a Houston home seen from above

inspection.title: What happens at a free inspection

steps.title: Send us the address
steps.text: Giving the address of the home gets you faster service.

steps.title: We get on the roof
steps.text: We come out and look the roof over. The inspection is free.

steps.title: You get an estimate
steps.text: We tell you what we found and what it costs. The estimate is free too.

areasText: We are at 9002 Sheldon Road in Houston, and we roof homes and businesses across the city.

facts.heading: Free Inspection and Estimate
facts.text: Contact us for a free inspection and/or estimate. For faster service, please enter your home address when you write to us.

facts.heading: Homes and Businesses
facts.text: Bayou Elite Roofing provides roofing services for your home and business.
